answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation-based Sybil resistance mechanism, where agents are assigned a unique identifier, such as "onyx" or "falcon". As agents participate in the network, they earn reputation tokens based on their contributions. At dawn of each epoch, agents with a high reputation score are designated as validators, while those with low scores are relegated to observer status, limiting their ability to influence the network, thereby making it costly for an attacker to create numerous fake identities.
